item.title: Review: Kenya seeks review of Saudi travel restrictions over Ebola

item.title: Review: Sifuna demands transparency over Mrima Hills mining project, questions benefits to Kwale residents
item.description: Linda Mwananchi Movement party leader Edwin Sifuna has demanded transparency in the proposed Mrima Hills mining project in Kwale, insisting that all agreements be made public and residents guaranteed a fair share of the mineral wealth.
